briefing.headline: OpenAI and xAI escalate multi-agent AGI race with new coordination benchmarks

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race has intensified with frontier labs releasing coordinated agent systems amid rising geopolitical stakes. Funding remains robust while regulatory scrutiny grows over autonomous capabilities.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4-preview with advanced multi-agent orchestration. Anthropic released Claude 4 Opus while xAI launched Grok-3 and DeepSeek introduced R2, all emphasizing agentic workflows.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines target agent-to-agent authentication.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft announced $40B hyperscale buildout in Texas while TSMC ramped 3nm AI chip production. Google TPU v6 clusters went live for internal training.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent systems achieve recursive self-improvement before 2028 regulatory frameworks can contain them?
